radeon RX 7000 SERIES
The Most Advanced Graphics for Gamers
Introducing the AMD Radeon™ RX 7000 Series graphics cards, featuring the breakthrough AMD RDNA™ 3 architecture, engineered to deliver powerhouse performance for all gamers. The AMD Radeon™ RX 7000 Series graphics cards power a new generation of competitive and 4K gaming with vivid visuals, and elevated experiences in every game and every frame.
XFX MERC319 RX 6900 XTXFX MERC319 RX 6800 XTXFX MERC319 RX 6800
POWERHOUSE
PERFORMANCE
Experience unprecedented performance, visuals, and efficiency at 4K and beyond with AMD Radeon™ RX 7000 Series graphics cards, the world’s first gaming GPUs powered by AMD RDNA™ 3 chiplet technology. Immerse yourself in breathtaking visuals with the pinpoint color accuracy of AMD Radiance Display™ Engine and boost frame rates with AMD FidelityFX™ Super Resolution and Radeon™ Super Resolution upscaling technologies.1,2 To unlock even more performance, combine AMD Radeon™ RX 7000 Series graphics and compatible AMD Ryzen™ processors to activate AMD smart technologies.3
VIVID
VISUALS
Discover new levels of fidelity and ultra-fast gameplay with High-Performance Rendering, a combination of compute-based AMD FideltyFX™ features and upscaling technologies, to deliver world-class visuals with remarkable performance. Further immerse yourself with the AMD Radiance Display™ Engine and DisplayPort™ 2.1 to experience up to 68 billion colors at up to 8K 165Hz.
ELEVATED
EXPERIENCES
Ultimate responsiveness and smooth gaming are up-leveled with low-latency gaming technology from AMD Radeon Anti-Lag and AMD Radeon Boost.1,2 Propel your gaming experience with the latest DisplayPort 2.1, HDMI™ 2.1 VRR technology, USB-C™ enabled VR headsets, or over 1250 AMD FreeSync™ technology-enabled gaming displays.3
RDNA 3
Breakthrough Performance
AMD Radeon™ RX 7000 Series graphics cards set a new standard for ultra-enthusiast class gaming performance. Featuring advanced AMD RDNA™ 3 compute units, blazing fast clock speeds, and chiplet technology to enable fluid, high-refresh rate gaming experiences. Breakthrough new levels of performance with up to 24GB of GDDR6 memory and 2nd generation AMD Infinity Cache™ to deliver an incredible experience at 4K and beyond.
Upsize Perfomrance.
Maximize fidelity
AMD FidelityFX™ Super Resolution technology1 takes upscaling technology to the next level. Providing incredible image quality while boosting framerates in supported games. AMD Radeon™ Super Resolution (RSR)2 leverages FSR technology on the driver level, giving you upscaled performance benefits across thousands of games.
Advanced gaming and
Creation Platform
Build the ultimate desktop when combining the latest Ryzen™ processors and Radeon™ graphics for breakthrough performance and remarkable power efficiency. Take your experience to the next level with AMD smart technologies4 and AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition™ applications. Radeon™ RX 7900 Series graphics are the ultimate plug-and-play solution, integrating seamlessly with existing ultra-enthusiast power supplies and cases with optimized system power, thermals, and noise levels.

XFX Speedster Radeon RX 7900 Series
Taking the lead.
The all new XFX AMD Radeon RX 7900 Series is the highest performance Radeon to date so if you are looking for the best of the best, look no further than the Radeon RX 7900 XTX and Radeon RX 7900 XT Mercury 310
XFX MERC319 RX 6900 XTXFX MERC319 RX 6800 XTXFX MERC319 RX 6800
Realistic Lighting, Shadows & Reflections
Real-Time Raytracing
The AMD Radeon™ RX 7900 XTX MERC 310 series graphics card, powered by AMD RDNA™ 3 architecture, featuring 96 powerful enhanced Compute Units, 96 Ray Accelerators, 2615 MHz Boost Frequency, 96 MB of all new AMD Infinity Cache and 24GB of dedicated GDDR6 memory, is engineered to deliver ultra-high frame rates and serious 4K resolution gaming.
Staying Cool.
Cooler than ever before. In addition to a huge pass through vent the new Mercury family of GPUs features plenty of heat dissipation all around including engineered airflow and exhaust, heat pipes, vapor chamber, dual ball bearing fans and plenty of thermal pads throughout the card.
The anatomy of a XFX GPU
A look inside.
Top Cover
Specific to the Black Edition 7900 Series MERC 310 cards. There is a premium one piece aluminum fanshroud cover which is both incredibly sturdy and light weight, improving indirect dissipation of ambient heat traps generated by the heatsink.
Premium Fans
Features 3 full-size 100mm fans. Made with dual ball bearings for ultra smooth operation that drastically extends the life of the fans. Paired with smart silent auto cooling detection sensors to keep your fans at optimal speeds.
Zipper Fin Heatsink
Features a full aluminum zipper fin heatsink with a staggered fin design to increase airflow and heat dissipation while simultaneously reducing noise caused by air friction.
Heatpipes
The new XFX Radeon RX 7000 series have nickel plated copper heatpipes using a staggered design which reduces a concentration of hotspots on the heatsink resulting in drastically improved heat dissipation.
Vapor Chamber
XFX has brought back our server grade vapor chamber for significantly improved heat transfer over standard copper and aluminum cold plates. Additionally we’ve taken that added step of nickel plating our copper vapor chamber to improve its overall quality.
Power Phase
XFX utilizes 12+3+2 full digital PWM power phase design on the RX 7900 XTX and 10+3+1 full digital PWM power design on the RX 7900 XT. This provides you with stable gameplay by better distributing power across more VRMs, also allowing for more headroom in overclocking.
Aluminum Backplate
Ridged Design
Our new Diecast Aluminum backplate has a ridged design, its surface area has been increased by 33% compared to our past backplates. When paired with thermal pads between it and the PCB, it allows for improved heat dissipation.
Simple & Elegant Design
